adopted_rules: Continue the commissioned complete pnb-Arab-PK edition; no current global benefit or priority rank is claimed.
Pakistan Punjabi Shahmukhi and Indian Punjabi Gurmukhi require separate natural-edition evidence, canon, terminology/register decisions and semantic QA.
Naskh and Nastaliq remain typography profiles over exactly one segment-aligned Shahmukhi semantic text.
Census Punjabi is not used as an exact Shahmukhi readership denominator or as evidence of translation benefit.
Any catch-up, foundational, early-literacy, pronunciation or oral companion is a separate artifact with its own coverage manifest and earns no credit toward the 722-unit OpenLogic corpus.

A future full-reader publication target retains semantic responsive HTML, reflowable EPUB 3.3, native MathML, meaningful-image descriptions and self-contained offline availability as baselines; these are not falsely claimed complete now.
workflow_effect: No lane cancellation, corpus shrink, duplicate script translation, companion diversion, current rank claim or reader acceptance. The active full-edition workflow and exact 722-unit denominator continue unchanged.
limits: This adoption records production constraints from a manager synthesis. It does not independently validate the underlying allocation study, establish a Top 10, measure translation benefit or add companion artifacts to scope.
